def factor_vol_regime_log_price_impact(df):
    """Conditional price impact with log-compressed absolute returns: difference in average log absolute returns between high-volume and low-volume days."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    log_abs_ret = np.log1p(ret.abs())
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, _ = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    high_sum = (log_abs_ret * is_high_vol).rolling(20, min_periods=1).sum()
    high_cnt = is_high_vol.rolling(20, min_periods=1).sum()
    low_sum = (log_abs_ret * is_low_vol).rolling(20, min_periods=1).sum()
    low_cnt = is_low_vol.rolling(20, min_periods=1).sum()
    avg_high = (high_sum / high_cnt.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
    avg_low = (low_sum / low_cnt.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
    factor = avg_high - avg_low
    df_copy["factor_vol_regime_log_price_impact"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vol_regime_log_price_impact"]
